intro.text: The Open Finance Insurance capabilities enable secure and efficient sharing of insurance policy data — empowering third-party providers (TPPs) with the tools they need to deliver policy aggregation, switching, broking, and value-added digital insurance services.
All services operate under strict consent management and granular data access permissions, mediated and validated by the API Hub.
